features.title: Review project and workspace changes by scope
features.summary: Choose a registered project or workspace and optional base bookmark, read its jj diff, group changed files with pulls.review's deterministic rules, and show every scope's diff in one scrollable review with locally persisted progress. The same grouping is available as the /pulls command in a thread and the pulls_review agent tool.
failureModes: A missing workspace, a workspace without a jj repository, no resolvable base bookmark, or a missing jj binary is reported with its own reason instead of an empty diff.
jj stderr never reaches the client; a failed command is classified, not quoted.
A patch larger than the Host cap, or one with more files than one message carries, is flagged as truncated and clipped rather than silently shortened or rejected.

externalDependencies.boundary: The jj CLI in the resolved thread workspace.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The e2e journey provisions a disposable jj repository; unit tests inject a scripted jj runner and check the real CLI output separately.

reach: expect textbox "Message or run a task, / commands, @ files or sessions"
fill textbox "Message or run a task, / commands, @ files or sessions" "/pulls"

telemetry.testName: records a jj diff span with flag names only

features.title: Summarize review scopes with the thread's own model
features.summary: One model call over the whole diff turns the deterministic scope summaries into short one-line-per-scope prose, using the provider the thread last requested with and the first model that provider offers.
failureModes: No thread provider, no offered model, or no Host llm service is reported as its own reason, never as an empty summary.
A review that failed, or a workspace with no changes, keeps its own reason instead of blaming the model.
An answer without a usable `key: text` line leaves the deterministic summaries in place.
An explicit provider/model from the caller wins over the thread route.

externalDependencies.boundary: The DSH llm service and the provider route the thread's session log records.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Unit tests inject a scripted complete() and route sources; the scratch profile has no provider, so its UI path can only be reached with a configured account.

verification.testName: reads one keyed line per scope
uses the thread provider with the first model it offers, and lends it the session id
reports no route when neither the caller nor the thread names a provider
reports an unusable answer instead of inventing summaries

verification.reason: A *successful* summary needs a configured provider account and the scratch/e2e profiles have none, so no browser journey can drive one. The failure footer is asserted by the catalog reach, and the route, protocol and failure paths by unit tests.

features.title: Mark a selection of changed files reviewed
features.summary: The review-wide selector covers files across every scope; per-file checkboxes can still extend or toggle the selection, and one action marks or clears it in local review progress. A plain click on Mark reviewed still toggles that file.
failureModes: A mark only ever covers paths in the current review, so changing the workspace or revision prunes ids the diff no longer lists.
The selection is presentation state and never touches the stored reviewed marks until the batch action runs.

verification.testName: marks and unmarks a batch without duplicating or dropping other paths

telemetry.reason: Client-only: Mark a selection of scope files reviewed renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.

reach: expect checkbox "Select all files in this review"
